description: This Java class `EncodedPassword` provides a representation for encoded passwords, including parsing, formatting, and creating instances from secret objects. It handles encoding/decoding salts in Base64, and supports password hashing details as used in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: EncodedPassword
classes.description: A final class encapsulating an encoded password, providing methods for parsing, formatting, and creating instances from secrets.

methods.name: EncodedPassword
methods.description: Constructor that parses a formatted password string.

methods.name: fromHonoSecret
methods.description: Static method to create an EncodedPassword instance from a Hono secret JSON object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Private method to parse formatted password string into salt and password.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the password in {Base64(salt)}password format.
